eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Levy, FL; at 9:14 AM on AUG 29, 2023 Effective until 10:14 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Levy county expecting life threatening storm surge along our coastline. We are expecting 11 to 15 foot of surge from Hurricane Idalia. Residents need to evacuate to a shelter away from the surge.
